senses.gloss: to leap, step.—Hif. הִדְרִיג to make a step (מַדְרֵגָה), i.e. to fell trees at uneven heights from the ground, so as to make the stumps appear like steps, opp. החליק to cut at even heights.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:5:2">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ</cite> bot. [read:] <he>לא יהא מחליק ומַדְרִיג מדריג ומחליק וכ׳</he> he must not cut one portion even and another step-like, but must make the stumps equally high; <he>מקום … יַדְרִיג לַדְרִיג יחליק</he> where it is the custom to cut even, he must (in the Sabbatical year) cut uneven &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:14">Tosef. ib. III, 14</cite> [read:] <he>ה״ז לא יחליק ויַדְרִיג וכ׳</he>. Y. Erub. VII, beg. 24ᵇ, v. <cite ref="K00357"><he>כּוֹפֶת</he></cite>.
